Spencer, Infrared bounds, phase transitions and continuous symmetry breaking, Communications in Mathematical Physics 50 (1976), 79-95; and A. Kargol, Y. Kondratiev and Y. external_authority.long_range_order_to_pressure_cusp: Kargol-Kondratiev-Kozitsky, arXiv:0710.2303, Proposition 3.9 and equations (3.19)-(3.27), applied to one scalar collective source

setup.parameters: hbar>0, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r<0 and beta>0
setup.coarse_volume: Lambda_L=(Z/LZ)^3 with V=L^3 along reflection-compatible even, and safely dyadic, periodic cubes

finite_loop_FKG.harmonic_reference: Choose an arbitrary positive onsite harmonic split so the periodic Ornstein--Uhlenbeck loop reference is proper; absorb the residual quadratic into the local potential.
finite_loop_FKG.time_slice_core: Every positive-weight Trotter time-slice density is MTP2: temporal Mehler bonds and spatial difference-square bonds have nonnegative mixed log derivatives, while every Q3 edge has d_x d_y W=-(lambda/2)(3x^2-4xy+3y^2)<=0.
finite_loop_FKG.limit: Quartic domination gives uniform integrability; marginalization and weak limits preserve MTP2/association for finite evaluation cylinders, hence the continuous-loop law is FKG for bounded increasing functionals and for the required coordinate products by moment truncation.
finite_loop_FKG.symmetry_consequence: At zero source global field inversion gives <q_e>=0, Q3 automorphism transitivity gives equal component variances, and FKG gives <q_e q_f>>=0. Therefore <Q_y^2>>=<|q_y|^2>/8.
finite_loop_FKG.source_boundary: Coordinatewise stochastic monotonicity holds for source directions with nonnegative components, including u. No mixed-sign source monotonicity is claimed.

collective_moment_bound.operator: A=V^(-1/2) sum_y u dot p_y on the polynomial Schwartz core, extended by spectral cutoff
collective_moment_bound.FKG_edge_improvement: Writing S_y=sum_e q_y,e^2 and D_y=sum_edges(q_y,e-q_y,f)^2, Q3 3-regularity and FKG give <D_y><=3<S_y>, while <Q_y^2>>=<S_y>/8.
collective_moment_bound.conclusion: The exact collective lower bound is <Q_y^2>>=theta_Q with theta_Q=-r/[3(g+lambda)]>0, where each >= is a lower-bound symbol and not equality. The weaker graph-spectrum estimate D_y<=6S_y is retained only as a hostile no-FKG control.

falk_bruch_and_ir.f_definition: f(0)=1 and f(x tanh x)=tanh(x)/x for x>0
falk_bruch_and_ir.spatial_RP: Treat each full R8 loop as one site spin in K=L2(S_beta;R8). Crossing kernels exp[c<a,b>_K] are positive by the symmetric-tensor expansion; nonradial Q3 terms remain onsite.
falk_bruch_and_ir.gaussian_domination: For every zero-sum K-valued spatial source j, log <exp(sum_y<j_y,omega_y>_K)> <= (1/(2c))<j,L_sp^(-1)j>.
falk_bruch_and_ir.infrared_bound: For p nonzero, Dhat_L(p)<=[2 beta c E(p)]^(-1), E(p)=sum_i(1-cos p_i).

explicit_phase_regime.x_beta: x_beta is the unique positive solution of x_beta*tanh(x_beta)=beta*hbar^2/(4chi*theta_Q)
explicit_phase_regime.method_boundary: If A0<=I3 or beta<=beta_star, this route is inconclusive and does not prove absence of a phase.

cusp_and_DLR_phase.Griffiths_normalization: The scalar collective moment-generating function and the Griffiths lemma give physical M_plus(u)>=sqrt(delta_beta). Since p=8beta P and p'_+(0)=beta M_plus(u), D_+P_beta(0)>=sqrt(delta_beta)/8.
cusp_and_DLR_phase.parity: D_-P_beta(0)=-D_+P_beta(0)<=-sqrt(delta_beta)/8, so the fine-pressure cusp gap is at least sqrt(delta_beta)/4.
cusp_and_DLR_phase.tangent_states: The EXP-000781 zero-source DLR tangent states obey integral Q_0 dmu_plus=8D_+P_beta(0)>=sqrt(delta_beta) and mu_minus is its parity image.
cusp_and_DLR_phase.phase: mu_plus and mu_minus are distinct tempered Euclidean DLR states. Thus the exact positive-lambda fixed-lattice model has a low-temperature DLR phase transition and spontaneous global-Z2 breaking in this explicit sufficient regime.
cusp_and_DLR_phase.state_boundary: The construction does not prove that these tangent states are extreme, pure, clustering, or the only phases.

prior_art_boundary: FKG/MTP2, reflection positivity, Gaussian domination, the infrared bound, Bruch--Falk inequality and Griffiths moment-to-pressure conversion are established methods. The repository-specific result is their exact hypothesis-by-hypothesis composition for the nonradial positive-lambda Q3LOCK onsite interaction, using Q3 submodularity and graph spectrum to replace the O(8)-rotation hypothesis of the closest published vector phase theorem. No claim of a new general phase method, historical priority or world-first status is made.
no_overclaim: This package proves an exact sufficient positive-lambda low-temperature DLR phase and collective-source cusp only when r<0, A0>I3 and beta>beta_star. It does not prove a phase for every parameter, the extremality, purity, clustering or completeness of the constructed phases, a pre-existing infinite-volume real-time dynamics or algebraic KMS condition, a ground-state phase or gap, continuum regulator removal, a physical empty-space reference or below-empty-space sign, an effective 3D-to-1+1 map, physical light, gravity, cooling or event-horizon emergence, or C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A or Pre-A completion.
